declarations.description:
Pick a free time from someone's calendar, the booking step of Calendly and Cal.com: a row of days on top, then the
free times of the day picked, grouped into morning, afternoon and evening.

`slots` lists the times, each an ISO `start` (with its offset), an optional `end`, and `available: false` for one
that is taken. They are shown in `time-zone` (the browser's zone by default) and filed under their day in that zone.
Days with a free time carry a dot; days between the first and last slot without one are disabled. A day with no
free time offers a jump to the next one that has.

The value is the picked slot's `start`, exactly as given. Paging the days fires `range-change` with the days now
shown, so an app can load their slots, showing `loading` meanwhile.

The times are one list box per group with a single tab stop: the arrow keys move from time to time across groups,
Home and End go to the first and last, and Enter or Space picks. It is a form control: under a `name` the form
receives the value, `required` asks for one, and it takes part in `c2-form-field`.

members.name: slots
members.description: The times to pick from. As an attribute, a JSON array of `{ start, end?, available?, label? }`.

members.name: value
members.description: The picked slot's `start`.

members.name: date
members.description: The day shown, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to the day of the value, else the first day with a free time.

members.name: timeZone
members.description: The IANA time zone the times are shown in (`Europe/Paris`). Defaults to the browser's.

members.name: groupBy
members.description: `period` groups the times into morning, afternoon and evening; `none` lists them as one group.

members.name: showEnd
members.description: Shows each time with its end ("9:00 – 9:30").

members.name: min
members.description: The earliest day that can be shown, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

members.name: max
members.description: The latest day that can be shown, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows placeholder times while the app loads the slots of the days shown.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives the value under it.

members.name: required
members.description: Asks for a time before the form submits.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the picker off; the value is kept and, as for a disabled form control, not submitted.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the picker. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: focusSlot
members.description: The slot holding the tab stop, by its `start`.

members.name: byDay
members.description: The slots by day in the zone shown, sorted by time; rebuilt when the slots or the zone change.

members.name: freeDays
members.description: Days with at least one free time, in order.

members.name: booked
members.description: Days between the first and last day with slots that have no free time, rebuilt with `byDay`.

members.name: defaultDate
members.description: The day shown while `date` is not set.

members.name: zone
members.description: The zone the times are shown in; an unknown name falls back to the browser's.

members.name: shownDate
members.description: The day shown: `date`, or the default worked out from the value and the slots.

members.name: markerCache

type.text: { days: string[]; locale: string; markers: { date: string; label: string }[] } | undefined

members.description: The strip's dots, labelled for screen readers; kept while the days and the language stay the same.

members.name: bookedDays
members.description: Days between the first and last day with slots that have no free time: known to be fully booked.

members.name: handleStripChange
members.description: The strip's own events stay inside: its `change` is a day, not this picker's value.

events.name: date-change
events.description: Fired when the user shows another day.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the user picks a time, before `change`. Read `value`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the user picks a time, with the slot. Not fired for programmatic changes.
Fired when the user pages the days, with the first and last day now shown.
events.name: range-change
